notes.title: Lily is live on Steam!
notes.content:
Lily is now [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/917130/Lily/]live on Steam![/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001431/291d0ad6a2f154cbd09d91905dd72b44b08d333f.png[/img]

[h1]What is lily?[/h1]
Lily is a playful music creation game for people of all ages and musical abilities – you don't need to be a musician to enjoy it.

[h1]What is the goal?[/h1]
Explore music and melody to produce delightful, tuneful lily ponds. Relax in a calming, creative experience in which there is no winning or losing – only artistic exploration and expression.

[h1]What do you do?[/h1]
In short, create musical lily ponds. Use lilies to compose looping melodies and develop musical patterns and harmonies. Develop intricate arrangements using lily pads to control the playback of lilies over time.

Peace. ✌
